$comment: Light theme for every rendered diagram. Single source of truth: scripts/render-diagrams.sh passes this to `mmdc -c`. Paired with mermaid.dark.config.json.
$fontFamilyRationale: Recursive Variable is a variable font bundled with mermaid-cli, so mmdc embeds it as 4 base64 faces in the SVG (~200KB). That makes label geometry identical on every renderer (GitHub, docs sites, PDF export) instead of depending on whichever of Verdana/Arial/Trebuchet the viewer happens to have. A generic stack would silently re-flow labels computed here under different metrics. It is also half the size of embedding Open Sans (20 faces), and it is the font mermaid itself recommends.
